data.one_liner: Platform detection across Flutter, Dart web, and desktop without errors
data.what_it_does: UniversalPlatform replaces dart.io.Platform to provide safe platform checks on Web, Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux. It exposes boolean getters like isIOS, isWeb, and desktopOrWeb.
use_when: You need to perform platform checks in your view or model layers
Your app targets Web and you want to avoid UnsupportedOperation errors
You want a single API for all supported platforms
avoid_when: You only target native mobile and can use dart.io.Platform safely
You need more advanced platform-specific APIs beyond simple checks
strengths: Works on all supported platforms including Web
weaknesses: Only provides platform checks, no other utilities
No support for platform-specific APIs beyond booleans
